ludlow-garage: The box office is at the venue, 342 Ludlow Avenue, and opens at 5 p.m. on scheduled show days only. Confirm the show and west hallway entrance arrangements before travelling.
We do have a box office located at 342 Ludlow Ave. Cincinnati, OH 45220 (at the venue).

The FAQ prohibits outside food and drink in both the venue and restaurant. It does not state a medical or dietary exception; confirm any necessary arrangements before arrival.
Can I bring snacks? No food or beverage may be brought in from outside the venue or restaurant.
The smoking policy prohibits tobacco, electronic cigarettes and vaping throughout the restaurant and concert venue, including seated areas and restrooms.
Smoking is not permitted in seated areas of the venue, restrooms, or anywhere in the restaurant or venue. This includes tobacco, electronic cigarettes, and vaping.

Permitted bags are clear bags up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches or small clutches up to 6 × 9 inches; clutches need not be clear. The FAQ says non-compliant bags must be returned to a vehicle or disposed of before entry.
Clear bags that do not exceed 12" x 12" x 6" . Small clutch bags that do not exceed 6" x 9" - these do not need to be clear.
Guests who arrive with non-compliant bags will be asked to return them to their vehicles or dispose of them before entering.

For a Solo Rider cart, call the individual golf course to reserve. Great Parks also allows players to schedule a demonstration to assess whether the cart will help them play; a reservation is not a fit or transfer assessment.

A Solo Rider cart can be reserved by calling the individual course. Players may also schedule a time for a demonstration of the cart to see if it will be a benefit and enable them to play and practice the game of golf.
The park is open daily from dawn to dusk. Facility opening periods differ, so the park’s general hours do not establish availability of rentals, indoor toilets or the Visitor Center.
Open daily from dawn until dusk

For privately owned boats, Great Parks says there is no public trailer launch ramp or trailer parking at Miami Whitewater Forest. Boats must be carried from the nearest parking area to designated launching locations; confirm any carrying or transfer assistance separately.

Sharon Woods, Miami Whitewater Forest & Winton Woods Public launch ramps for trailered boats and trailer parking is not available or provided. Designated launching areas are only accessible by foot. Watercraft must be portaged (carried) from the nearest parking area. Launching of privately owned watercraft is permitted at designated launch locations only.

Privately owned watercraft may be used from dawn to dusk, but not when ice is present, lake water covers the launch area or severe weather exists. These are boating restrictions, not evidence that a particular transfer system is operating.
Privately owned watercraft are not permitted on the lake when there is ice present, lake levels rise to cover the launch area or severe weather conditions exist.
Use of privately owned watercraft is permitted from dawn to dusk.

The park lists a 1.2-mile Shaker Trace Inner Loop with exercise stations and a 7.7-mile Outer Loop through prairies and wetlands. These distances do not establish slopes, rest-point spacing or a continuous step-free route; see the separate paving notice.
Shaker Trace Inner Loop A section of the trail follows the Dry Fork Creek. Exercise stations are featured along the way. ‎ Length: 1.2 Miles

Shaker Trace Outer Loop Winds through prairies and wetlands, offering a scenic ride or walk through rare habitats. Spot birds, turtles, and butterflies, and pause at the wildlife shelter for a tranquil view of the wetlands. ‎ Length: 7.7 Miles
